defmodule MLInference.ModelRegistry do
  use GenServer

  @moduledoc """
  Registry for ML model references. Manages model lifecycle including
  loading, caching, and eviction based on memory pressure.
  """

  defstruct [:models, :ref_counts, :eviction_queue, :max_models]

  def start_link(opts) do
    max = Keyword.get(opts, :max_models, String.to_integer(System.get_env("ML_MAX_CACHED_MODELS") || "16"))
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %__MODULE__{models: %{}, ref_counts: %{}, eviction_queue: :queue.new(), max_models: max}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def acquire_model(model_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:acquire, model_id})
  end

  def release_model(model_ref) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:release, model_ref})
  end

  def handle_call({:acquire, model_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.models, model_id) do
      nil ->
        {model_ref, new_state} = load_and_register(model_id, state)
        {:reply, {:ok, model_ref}, new_state}
      existing_ref ->
        new_counts = Map.update(state.ref_counts, model_id, 1, &(&1 + 1))
        {:reply, {:ok, existing_ref}, %{state | ref_counts: new_counts}}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:release, model_ref}, state) do
    case find_model_id(model_ref, state) do
      nil -> {:noreply, state}
      model_id ->
        new_counts = Map.update!(state.ref_counts, model_id, &(&1 - 1))
        new_state = %{state | ref_counts: new_counts}
        maybe_evict_async(new_state)
        {:noreply, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp load_and_register(model_id, state) do
    new_state = maybe_evict_sync(state)
    model_ref = MLInference.NIF.load_model(model_id)
    models = Map.put(new_state.models, model_id, model_ref)
    counts = Map.put(new_state.ref_counts, model_id, 1)
    queue = :queue.in(model_id, new_state.eviction_queue)
    {model_ref, %{new_state | models: models, ref_counts: counts, eviction_queue: queue}}
  end

  defp maybe_evict_sync(state) when map_size(state.models) >= state.max_models do
    evict_one(state)
  end
  defp maybe_evict_sync(state), do: state

  defp maybe_evict_async(state) do
    # Environment-controlled eager eviction threshold
    eager_threshold = String.to_integer(System.get_env("ML_EAGER_EVICT_THRESHOLD") || "0")
    if eager_threshold > 0 do
      spawn(fn -> check_and_evict_eager(eager_threshold) end)
    end
  end

  defp check_and_evict_eager(threshold) do
    # Race: reads state, then sends eviction request after delay
    Process.sleep(threshold)
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, :evict_idle)
  end

  def handle_cast(:evict_idle, state) do
    idle_models = Enum.filter(state.ref_counts, fn {_id, count} -> count <= 0 end)
    new_state = Enum.reduce(idle_models, state, fn {model_id, _}, acc ->
      do_evict(model_id, acc)
    end)
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  defp evict_one(state) do
    case :queue.out(state.eviction_queue) do
      {{:value, model_id}, rest} ->
        count = Map.get(state.ref_counts, model_id, 0)
        if count <= 0 do
          new_state = do_evict(model_id, %{state | eviction_queue: rest})
          new_state
        else
          # Skip actively used model, try next
          evict_one(%{state | eviction_queue: rest})
        end
      {:empty, _} -> state
    end
  end

  defp do_evict(model_id, state) do
    case Map.get(state.models, model_id) do
      nil -> state
      model_ref ->
        MLInference.NIF.free_model(model_ref)
        %{state | models: Map.delete(state.models, model_id), ref_counts: Map.delete(state.ref_counts, model_id)}
    end
  end

  defp find_model_id(model_ref, state) do
    Enum.find_value(state.models, fn {id, ref} -> if ref == model_ref, do: id end)
  end
end

defmodule MLInference.NIF do
  @moduledoc "NIF bindings for native model operations"

  def load_model(model_id) do
    # Returns opaque reference to native memory
    :erlang.make_ref() |> then(&{&1, model_id})
  end

  def free_model(_model_ref) do
    # Releases native memory backing the model
    :ok
  end

  def infer(model_ref, input_tensor) do
    # Uses native memory pointed to by model_ref
    # UAF if model_ref was freed by eviction
    {:ok, %{ref: model_ref, input: input_tensor, result: :rand.uniform()}}
  end
end

defmodule MLInference.Worker do
  @moduledoc "Handles inference requests with model lifecycle management"

  def run_inference(model_id, input) do
    {:ok, model_ref} = MLInference.ModelRegistry.acquire_model(model_id)
    try do
      # Simulate preprocessing delay
      preprocess_time = String.to_integer(System.get_env("ML_PREPROCESS_MS") || "10")
      Process.sleep(preprocess_time)
      MLInference.NIF.infer(model_ref, input)
    after
      MLInference.ModelRegistry.release_model(model_ref)
    end
  end
end

defmodule MLInference.Server do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/predict" do
    %{"model" => model_id, "input" => input} = conn.body_params
    case MLInference.Worker.run_inference(model_id, input) do
      {:ok, result} -> send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(result))
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 500, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
    end
  end
end
